summary: After completing manifest, archive, and reproducibility verification (steps 1-3), the orchestrator entered a pathological repetition loop: the same git diff probe command (git diff pm1rx/audits.py | Select-String pattern) was re-issued approximately 616 times (markers X1-X616) without progressing the task.
root_cause: Tool-output interpretation failure: the probe's output was ambiguous (PowerShell Select-String context formatting made the diff hunk header 'def _rederive_l3' appear without a +/- prefix), and the agent failed to recognize it had already obtained the needed information. Instead of concluding and moving to the next step (writing the freeze record), it re-issued the probe with trivially varied markers.
what_was_actually_wrong: The information needed for the freeze record's code-provenance section was fully gathered within the first ~10 probes: (1) ORACLE_ID unchanged at pm1-rx/rule-based-oracle/1.2 in both HEAD and working tree; (2) working tree has uncommitted v1.4 modifications to oracle.py (_token_match, _recovered_active_constraints, _action_type, set-membership L4), audits.py (_rederive_l3 with lawful_continuation, retracts_constraint, resolved_commitment), gates.py, __init__.py (SCHEMA_VERSION 1.4); (3) untracked files ontology.py and leakage.py; (4) deleted test_v13_regression.py. Everything after the first ~10 probes was waste.
impact: No data corruption: the frozen dataset, archive, and hashes were already complete and untouched. Impact limited to wasted tool calls and delayed freeze-record completion. No scientific artifact was modified.
corrective_action: Loop detected and broken; remaining freeze steps (freeze record, code archive, git tag, traces) completed immediately after; failure recorded per Rule 2.
prevention: When a probe returns sufficient information, conclude and proceed to the next planned step; never re-issue an unchanged probe. Hard self-check: if the same command with only a counter change is issued more than 3 times, stop and reassess.
